title: A Orchard for the Letter
author: Beatrix Whitlock
blurb: Bram Sterling, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
